notes.title: The Darkness Is Thickening
notes.content:
In this update, there are new systems, such as:
- Two types of weapons
- Zombies
- Redesigned some screamers
- 3 stages of passing
- 3 places (parking, first and second floor of the hospital)
- New menu
- Graphics and sound settings
- Redesigned light (for comfortable gameplay)
- Redesigned some tasks

A little bit about zombies: Each zombie has different characteristics, some stronger, some weaker. Keep in mind that they are strong, and a few blows can be fatal for you.

About weapons: You will have two types of weapons at your disposal. Each of them has several modes. (Single, Automatic, Triple). You will also have a full supply of ammunition. There is no ammunition on the location, so take care of the ammunition, otherwise you will face imminent death

About the menu: The menu has been completely updated with graphics settings.
Also added to the menu is the ability to adjust the sound volume and effects. (Note: The volume of the screams cannot be changed.)
In the menu settings, a button has been added: Delete game save.

About the graphics: Some textures were redesigned and more light was added to make it clear where to go, so I didn't add a mini-map

About tasks: Some tasks have been removed and others added.

About future updates: The game in the future will probably receive small innovations, system improvements, graphics and much more, it will depend on the reviews.

Note: Please write your suggestions for improving the game under this ad.

notes.title: The Forgotten Past
notes.content:
Due to the fact that few people liked the concept of the game, the game will receive a major update and redesign.
In the new update:
- Weapons
- Updated map
- Removed all screamers
- Mini-map
- New tasks
- An AI that will hunt you down
- Location of the boss
- Location "Parking"
- New lighting
The update will be released in June
You can also write your wishes under this post that you want to see in the game.

notes.title: "Major pre-release Update"
notes.content:
May 25-the game will receive a "Major pre-release Update".
The update will include a practical, complete graphics and design update.
In addition, the game will receive additional functionality.
Also, depending on your wishes, new languages will be added, if necessary.

Please note: The following updates will be released every week or two, depending on the reviews.

notes.title: Multilingualism
notes.content:
Multilingualism and more
At the moment, we are translating the game into other languages, as well as adding more content, horror and scary elements to the game.
Add decor and more as you upgrade.
Our goal when releasing the game is to translate the game into all available languages of the platform. We do our best for you.
The following languages:
- French
- Ukrainian
- Polish
- Japanese
- Italian
- Arabic
Write the languages you would like to see!
